title: Audit P104 cross-axis encoding mismatch and exact boundary transition
body:
The proposed P104 row encoding does not match the reversed column encoding at the retained two-stage boundary. On constant address functions, a two-unit pivot input produces 48 extra signed-unit Y fields in the row representation and none in the column representation. A common completed C commutes with each encoding separately; it does not cancel their difference.

This package derives the exact literal-slot transition `K = S Pi_c L_c S L_r^-1 Pi_r`, retaining physical source/target orientation and both dirty-helper banks. A direct common-chart factor word is fully counted (179,712 unit ADD/SUBs, 21,632 halves and restoring doubles each, 19,968 signs and slot swaps each), with physical transports/owners/precision explicitly unpriced. Under PR[3954](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954)'s unchanged named scaffold hypotheses, even free interface work leaves the existing 44,096 rank-mass deficit. Stop native expansion for that contract.

Scope: an exact interface lemma and physical constant-sector counterexample. The canonical caller supplies a two-stage boundary, but does not supply an actual adjacent completed P104 pair. The reversed-column encoding is an explicitly proposed swapped-role contract, not an admitted inverse native word. No supplier, new kappa, runtime gain or frontier change.

Scientific head: `afd6bb0a701e9ffd685f27674adaac86687e5f02`; root tree `709f05c21826efa6f6fad3cdcaed5069ae5cf546`; canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority 6. Two scoped commits add 11 files only under `research/p104-encoded-boundary/`. Three canonical-main live inputs; no unmerged source dependency.

Verification: primary root/matrix reconstruction and all 208 local inverse basis fields; independent dense all-column checks on four common/varying-chart fixtures and 12 failure controls; six behavioral tests including optimized Git-free read-only export, corrupt/missing source and false results. Registered Python 3.12 replay and exact-public-head publication-byte/source-history preflight pass. Final-head hosted CI passes, as recorded below. No human/kernel audit or selected cold replay claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-encoded-boundary
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-encoded-boundary --check-source-history
```

Taken from PR[3954](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954)'s handoff under the [coordinated three-scope claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954#issuecomment-6261590999). Main and overlap refreshed; root checked all 662 open PR bodies including drafts and bounded live Discussions. The pre-submission latest-100 delta found new distinct P112 PR[3960](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3960) and the updated, different PR[3577](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3577) coefficient-consumer scope. This item excludes sibling private-COPY retirement/coverage studies and PR[3956](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3956)'s completed adapter comparison. The next obligation is an actual chronological completed-call pair with matched physical encoding, helper maps and fixed returns, together with a changed favorable complete bill.

Credit Chris R / Clear1nsight's PR[3882](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3882)/[3940](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3940)/[3943](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3943)/[3954](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3954) representations, caller and gate; ToikY/PR[3956](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3956) comparison; Rohan Arun/PR[1972](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1972), Chafik Boukhalfa/PR[1991](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1991), Adam Gall/PR[1940](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1940), Josie Elliston/E8, Sagar Thakrar/PR[1012](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1012), Douglas Colkitt, Dominik Scholz and retained native/compiler/occupancy lineage. New audit by Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate agent scope and root cross-check. Apache-2.0. No merge or selected-frontier change.

Final-head offline confirmation: all three commands pass under -I -O -B from the official Git-free read-only export, with all 15 exported hashes and modes unchanged. Archive SHA256 `52a3d0c1fc9dab45856d3cc11ce443325e9bf316dcac8c17df1d530904981246`. The first official cold replay exposed copied read-only modes in destructive-test fixtures; the second commit changes only three lines to make owned temporary copies writable. Scientific inputs, proof and numerical result are unchanged. [Hosted run 39214265329](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39214265329) passes at final head afd6bb0a701e9ffd685f27674adaac86687e5f02 on first attempt, testing merge2edcb82477ac3b617abe7bf4e6483b5651256b7e against unchanged main20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90. Planning, all three registered commands and git diff --exit-code pass on hosted Python 3.12.15: primary audit, separate104-column/four-chart checker, all 12 operator controls and all six behavioral groups. These execution checks preserve the scoped claims and remaining physical/supplier obligations.
